title: Lockups
p1: Lockups are graphic assets that pair our Rectio logos with additional elements like taglines, campaign lines, or partner logos.
p2: This page provides downloadable asset packs for two lockup categories: brand lockups for use on video end cards and other core communications, and vendor-tagged asset lockups used by vendors to promote their products on rectio.com and in our stores.
heading: Download resources here:
sub: Each asset pack contains a PDF guide with usage tips and individual lockup files.
